{{Season|Any}} in [[Secret Woods]], [[The Sewers]], or [[Mutant Bug Lair]] |weather = Any |difficulty = 15 |behavior = Mixed |size = 15-51 |price = 30 |edibility = 5 |roe = Yellow }} '''Carp''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the [[The Mountain#Fishing|mountain lake]] or [[Farm Maps|Wilderness Farm]] during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], or [[Fall]]. It can also be caught in the [[Secret Woods]], [[The Sewers]], or the [[Mutant Bug Lair]] during any season. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring, Summer and Fall, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|30}}. Carp is always most abundant in the Secret Woods, comprising between 41% and 53% of all items caught there when it isn't raining. ==Map== The Carp can be found in the [[The Mountain|mountain lake]], [[Secret Woods]], [[The Sewers|Sewers]], and [[Mutant Bug Lair]]. {{Map|270|43|loc2x=10|loc2y=100|loc3x=124|loc3y=184}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Linus |hate=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus }} ==Bundles== Carp is used in the {{Bundle|Lake Fish||y}}. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Carp Surprise|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Carp can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt157.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Fishing Vest]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Fish Pond== Carp can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every day. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing two quests. The only possible output is yellow Carp [[Roe]]. (You get to keep the fish). *Two Carp may be requested by [[Dorado]], [[Lingcod]], or [[Pike]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5. ==Note== *Carp are one of the easiest fish to catch, rarely moving past the 3rd bar on the fishing meter in the fishing mini-game, making it easy to get "Perfect" on its catches. ==References== See Data/Fish.xnb and GameLocation::CheckGenericFishRequirements in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.4|Added iridium quality.
